capabilities: Browse vault folders as grid, masonry or list card galleries
Generate whole-Canvas, Markdown, image and PDF first-page thumbnails
Manage files via drag-and-drop moves, rename, delete and system reveal
Pin favorite folders and remember per-folder view, sort and filter
Browse files in a dedicated sidebar tab with native file explorer menus
disambiguation: Not an image gallery only; it renders file cards for notes, Canvases and PDFs and acts as an alternative file browser.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.7+ and the Files core plugin. Makes no network requests or telemetry; PDF.js is bundled locally. Mobile support (iOS/Android) is new in 0.1.19 with unverified physical-device coverage. 'Craft-style' views are visual references only; no Craft code is included.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lists files as text rows, offering no visual thumbnails or previews of note, Canvas or PDF contents.

relations.evidence: Rendering and cache design draw on Embed Canvas, Gallery Navigator, the JSON Canvas specification

summary: Visual file browser that shows vault folders as card galleries with whole-Canvas, Markdown, image and PDF first-page previews.
